paragraphs: A homily of his survives in Nedarim 32a: when Moses our teacher neglected circumcision, Af and Chema—Anger and Wrath—came and swallowed him, etc.[^1][^2]

notes.text: לב. is 32 with a period that may be ordinary clause punctuation; machine comma differs. The retained 32a is the prior source-supported locator reported in the frozen record, not a fresh check or an inference that every period proves a side.

Af and Chema as personifications of Anger and Wrath are the preserved prior consulted-passage interpretation, not a fresh verification. Hyman abbreviates with etc.; no missing circumcision object or continuation is supplied. Moses our teacher preserves רבינו as a separate supplied designation, not title evidence for the headed Yehudah. The heading title remains R'.
